svg.text: One knob at a time: what moves, and how much
Toy model, ABS, 0.45 × 0.2 mm at 150 mm/s, 250 °C, 50 °C chamber, 20 mm melt zone. Green is better for the part, red is worse, blue is neither
Corner error is in percentage points of flow during acceleration, with PA left where it was tuned. Weld time and Z strength use the 1/4 power from chapter 6
